error-semantics.skeleton: ERROR means an operational, configuration, or input error prevented a policy verdict; no report verdict is produced. It is distinct from BLOCK, which is a completed policy outcome.

metric-limits.skeleton: The displacement metric applies to modified shared IDs only; the report does not establish source positional accuracy.

no-supported-intent.skeleton: ABSTAIN: this question does not match a supported deterministic report query. Ask about the verdict, policy threshold, relationship changes, primary feature changes, metrics, provenance, or evidence limits.

policy-meaning.skeleton: The analysis completed and the configured threshold was exceeded; BLOCK is not an operational failure.
The configured relationship-regression policy was not exceeded; PASS is not a claim that source data are correct.

provenance-absent-v*.skeleton: {{report_version}} has no provenance object. V5 adds input-byte SHA-256 identities and engine versions without changing the spatial semantics.

provenance-datasets.skeleton: Logical datasets named: {{analysis.primary_dataset}}; no dependency datasets.

provenance-limit.skeleton: Hashes identify the report's declared raw input bytes but do not identify who supplied them or establish their license rights.

provenance-source-limits.skeleton: These are logical dataset names; the report does not include source URLs or data-license rights.

relationship-limits.skeleton: No changed dependent relationship rows are recorded in this report, although primary feature changes are present.
No changed dependent relationship rows are recorded in this report.
These are declared geometric membership changes under the report's predicate; they do not establish legal, causal, access, service-use, or socioeconomic impact.

uncertainty-missing.skeleton: ABSTAIN: this report schema has no calibrated uncertainty interval, confidence value, or source positional accuracy field, so this input cannot support a quantitative uncertainty claim.

unsupported-claim.skeleton: ABSTAIN: the report cannot establish a real-world cause, harm, legal effect, or service outcome. It records declared geometric relationships and a configured policy result.

unsupported-temporal-geographic.skeleton: ABSTAIN: the report has no timestamp, acquisition date, place name, or administrative geography field, so it cannot support a temporal or geographic interpretation. Coordinates are expressed only in the analysis CRS.
